rules: UI placement never determines code ownership.
Each app has one domain-owned frontend feature path even when it appears in multiple launchpad placements.
Business features are theme-agnostic and contain no theme-selection logic.
Business screens use real API data; fixtures belong only in tests and database seed tooling.
Route and floorplan become canonical only after the app TDD is approved.
Current repository architecture and approved FDD/TDD documents are the only implementation authority.
